notes.title: February 12, 2021 update
notes.notes:
We have made a medium-sized update to the game system.
We have changed it to make it easier to play.
The changes are as follows.

・Cleared areas can be selected.
・File compression.
・Organized the number of items and changed the display method.
・Added a bad ending song.
・Abolition of ladders and keys.
・Fixed minor bugs.
